research_question: In this synthetic marketplace pilot, does expedited shipping improve sales without increasing returns?

documents.title: SYNTHETIC: Urban pilot A
documents.text: Urban orders rose by 12% with expedited shipping. Returns were unchanged. The pilot lasted two weeks.

documents.title: SYNTHETIC: Urban replication B
documents.text: Urban orders did not increase with expedited shipping. Returns were unchanged. Price changes may explain the difference.

documents.title: SYNTHETIC: Rural pilot C
documents.text: Rural orders fell with expedited shipping. Long-term retention was not measured.

evidence.quote: Urban orders rose by 12% with expedited shipping.
Urban orders did not increase with expedited shipping.
Rural orders fell with expedited shipping.

questions.question: Would a longer randomized pilot controlling for price resolve the sales disagreement?
